title: Aye Jaan-e-dil-e-Hyder-e-Karrar Alamdaar
body:
Aye Jaan-e-dil-e-Hyder-e-Karrar Alamdaar
Aye quwath-e-Sibtey Shahey Abraar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Taa hashr teri yaad zamaaney main rahegi
Aye Sarwar-e-aalam kay Wafadaar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Marney sey teray lashkar-e-Sheh hogayaa barbaad
Aye fouj-e-Hussaini kay Alamdaar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashey pay teray Sarwar-e-aalam ka bayaan hai
Aye meray museebath kay madadgaar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dikhlaadoh phir ek baar mujhey chaand si soorath
Martaa hai tera taaleb-e-deedaar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Darya sey uttho Bhaayi ki imdaad ko aao
Tanhaa hai yeh ab beykas-o-naachaar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Rothi hai bhatijee usay doh aakay dilaasa
Saqqaa-e-Sakina meray Jarraar Alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab takh saff-e-maatam meri duniya main bicheygi
Royengay tujhey meray azadaar Alamdaar
